captions.title: Tap the alert that needs you
captions.line: It is under Needs you on home, marked Do this.

captions.title: Read what AV Homes said
captions.line: It says exactly what is missing from your proof.

captions.title: Add the photo they asked for
captions.line: Tap From phone. The new one is marked New.

captions.title: Add a short note
captions.line: Say what you changed. It is not required.

captions.title: Send it back
captions.line: The new photo and your note go in one tap.

captions.title: It is back to Being checked
captions.line: AV Homes checks it again, usually in a day or two.
